Title: Armour Class and you
Author: Warrior Tutor Yttribium
Notes: Naked base AC = 100 - level (all classes, ->1 at lvl99); dmg = raw x (1 + AC/100); human cap -80, mob -95; range +100..-128, shows +127 when overcapped.

Title: Swing damage & Mods
Author: Rogue Tutor Melalye
Notes: Warrior/Rogue melee swing = [(S/2)*Ingr + Dam*2.5 + Mgt/8 + 9(W)/7.5(R)] * Rage * Inv * Crit. Ingress/Rage/Cunning value tables. Behind = x2; side = no bonus. Hit vs Grace accuracy prose.

Title: Weapon Damage Breakdown

Title: Spell damage and various info
